a: Although the client was unhappy, we kept the contract.

ok.en: Right: sentence a. Although concedes the contradiction: unhappy, yet we kept the contract.

wrong.de: In b nennt because den Grund: Der Kunde war der Anlass, den Vertrag zu behalten.
wrong.en: In b, because gives the reason: the client was the cause for keeping the contract.

wrong.de: Nicht gleich: although nennt einen Widerspruch, because einen Grund.
wrong.en: Not the same: although names a contradiction, because names a reason.

a: Despite the strike, the trains ran on time.
b: Because of the strike, the trains ran late.

wrong.de: In b nennt because of den Grund für die Verspätung. Der Streik hat also aufgehalten.
wrong.en: In b, because of gives the reason for the delay. So the strike did hold things up.

wrong.de: Nicht gleich: despite sagt trotz, because of sagt wegen.
wrong.en: Not the same: despite says in spite of, because of says due to.

wrong.en: Not the same: b names a time span, a names a comparison.

wrong.en: In b, therefore gives a result: lateness makes people satisfied? That makes no sense.

wrong.de: Nicht gleich: however zeigt einen Gegensatz, therefore eine Folge.
wrong.en: Not the same: however shows a contrast, therefore shows a result.
